nodes.title: HTGTS
nodes.scope: Architecture of the supplied Illumina HTGTS explanatory schematic: one end-processed, adapter-first DNA-library route from genomic material to purified sequencing-end-tagged DNA. All eight depicted transformations and bead attachment are retained; no alternative branch or sequencing run is drawn. Biological joining is upstream context. Hu et al. Figure 1a supports interpretation of this implementation, while Chiarle et al. support the bait–prey principle but report different experimental library routes. Explicit repertoire and linear-amplification variants are qualified in method_scopes without importing unshown operations into the graph. Publication metadata and catalogue timestamps are not used to establish invention or priority.
